_: Facial skin of the cheek and forehead: sebum-rich (400-900 glands/cm2), thin stratum corneum (~9 layers), many sebaceous follicles; dermis 1.3-2.2 mm. Values for the living adult face at rest, room conditions; 'oily' = a heavy sebum or oil film, distinct from the natural casual sebum level. SKIN lane 11-07.

alpha.src: SPEC cheek m 0.271, forehead m 0.270 (GGX alpha = Beckmann m)

n.src: SPEC mapping F0 = 0.0255 rho_s / 0.25: cheek rho_s 0.234 -> n 1.365, forehead 0.272 -> n 1.4; mean

structure.src: SRL (F1 SC layers, F2 RCM epidermis, F5 dermis US); HEADFACE F8 ultrasound totals (45 women)

n.src: as skin.body (Jacques 2013 soft tissue); sebum film n 1.48-1.50 (MOIST O9)

optics_summary.note: colour layers come from the skin colour model; this block is a summary only

kinetic.src: dry: skin.body's 0.5 x the forehead / mean-site ratio on one probe 0.34 / 0.21 (CUA90: forehead highest, with the postauricular site; ascribed to sebum and hydration) = 0.8; wet: as skin.body (DERLER12); oily (flooding oil film): dry-skin x 0.25 (ZHANGMAK99, BOBJER93)

static.src: static taken equal to kinetic (skin friction is reported almost only as dynamic)

friction.counterface: smooth hard probe as skin.body unless stated

surface_energy_mJ_m2.src: KRUSS non-degreased forehead skin (OWRK); MAVON97 via US patent 6846490: forehead CST 50.7 -> 29.3 mN/m when sebum extracted; forehead a monopolar basic (electron-donor) surface (MAVON97)

tack.v: sebum makes the forehead more wettable and higher-friction than the forearm (CUA90, MAVON97)

water_contact_angle_deg.src: not retrieved as a number; forehead more wettable than the forearm's ~91 deg (MAVON97, higher CST)

restitution.src: skin over a thick fat pad on bone: inside skin.body's range

resistivity_ohm_m.src: 1 / sigma: stratum corneum 2e-4 to 2e-3 S/m and wet skin 0.059 S/m at low frequency (GABRIEL96 via the Frontiers compiled table); DC dry stratum corneum is higher still and falls steeply with depth (YAMAMOTO76, numbers not retrieved)

E_kPa.src: FENG22 OCE forearm incl. stratum corneum (small strain)

poisson.src: near-incompressible soft tissue (FENG22 / LAYERS use 0.5; 0.49 keeps a solver stable)

compressible_to_fraction.src: a stiff thin shell: thins little under contact (E)

thickness_mm.src: HEADFACE F8 buccal 1.37 / zygomatic 1.30 mm total (cheek)

poisson.src: near-incompressible soft tissue (FENG22 / LAYERS use 0.5; 0.49 keeps a solver stable)

thickness_mm.src: HEADFACE F1 22-26 mm over the molar cheek to bone (soft tissue total less skin, rounded)

E_kPa.src: TAKEMOTO24 left cheek ~4.0 kPa (right 9.9 kPa) whole-tissue indentation, one man

poisson.src: near-incompressible soft tissue (FENG22 / LAYERS use 0.5; 0.49 keeps a solver stable)

contact_stiffness_kPa_per_mm.src: series stack of compliance_layers: E_eff = T / sum(t_i / E_i) = 4.26 kPa over T 21.46 mm, / T; initial (small-strain) value; each layer stiffens with strain (skin as skin.body; the cheek's fat flows)

ramp.src: IPC-style log barrier inside collision_thickness keeps surfaces apart; the tissue's own stiffening (exponential in strain) carries the load beyond it

contact_damping_ratio.src: between thigh and breast values (no face value)

wave_speed_m_s.src: sqrt(G / rho): dermis 13.3 kPa; cheek whole tissue G = 4.0 / 3 kPa

damping_ratio.src: between thigh and breast values (no face value)

model.src: small-strain face; hyperelastic fits of face skin not found

E_kPa.src: FENG22 layers (forearm, applied); TAKEMOTO24 cheek whole-tissue indentation

expression_motion_mm.src: HEADFACE F11 / F12 surface displacement in expression

conductivity_W_mK.src: ITIS v5.0 (DOI 10.13099/VIP21000-05-0), live table re-read 11-08: Skin average 0.372 W/mK (SD 0.059, 8 studies, range 0.322-0.498); 0.37 kept

heat_capacity_J_kgK.src: ITIS v5.0 (DOI 10.13099/VIP21000-05-0), live table re-read 11-08: Skin average 3390.5 J/kgK (SD 233, 4 studies, 3150-3662)

density_kg_m3.src: ITIS v5.0 (DOI 10.13099/VIP21000-05-0), live table re-read 11-08: Skin average 1109 kg/m3 (SD 38, n 10, 1100-1125); ICRU44 ~1090: recalled, not re-read

effusivity.src: sqrt(k rho c) from the three ITIS values above, J m-2 K-1 s-1/2 (the 'feels warm/cold' number)

emissivity.src: STEKETEE73 abstract re-read 11-08 (paper paywalled; abstract text via a reproduction): skin 0.98 +/- 0.01, independent of wavelength over the measured 1-14 um; white, black and burnt skin measured (normal = burnt); separate per-pigment values are not given in the abstract

washed.src: sebum removed: less gloss (SPEC sebum_note: gloss +21 % forehead 0.5 -> 6 h after washing, Jang 2018); alpha step E

oily_6h.src: 6 h after washing gloss +21-24 %, glossy area x4.1 (SPEC sebum_note); forehead refills to its casual level in ~3 h (MOIST O4)

sweaty.src: forehead sweats most (passive heat 0.99, exercise 3.39 mg/cm2/min, MOIST E4/E5); hydrated skin friction > 1 (DERLER12)
